s.note: delivered through the window by boat
s.how: Heat 1 tbsp oil in a large non-stick pan and add 24 frozen pork dumplings flat side down. Fry 2 minutes until the bottoms are golden, add 120ml water, cover and steam 6 minutes until the water is gone. Fry 1 more minute to re-crisp. Mix 3 tbsp black vinegar with 1 tbsp chilli oil and sliced spring onion for dipping.

Peel 16 king prawns, leaving the tails on, and toss with 2 crushed garlic cloves, 1 chopped red chilli, the zest and juice of 1 lime and 2 tbsp oil. Thread onto 8 skewers and grill 2 minutes a side until pink and charred. Serve on ice with 100ml sweet chilli sauce and lime wedges.

m.note: hot and fast, handed through the window with chopsticks
m.how: Slice 400g pork shoulder thin and toss with 1 tbsp soy sauce. Stir-fry in a smoking wok with 2 tbsp oil for 3 minutes. Add a quarter of a cabbage, shredded, and 1 carrot cut into matchsticks, stir-fry 2 minutes. Add 800g fresh udon, 3 tbsp oyster sauce, 2 tbsp soy sauce and 2 tbsp Shaoxing wine, toss until glossy and finish with sliced spring onion.

w.how: Warm 300ml coconut milk with 60g caster sugar, add 2 softened gelatine leaves, pour into four glasses and chill 2 hours. Steep 2 tbsp dried butterfly pea flowers in 300ml boiling water for 5 minutes, strain, stir in 40g sugar and 2 softened gelatine leaves, cool and pour over. Chill 3 hours. Squeeze lemon on top at the table and watch it turn purple.

d.how: Chill four martini glasses in the freezer for 30 minutes. For each drink, stir 60ml gin with 10ml dry vermouth over plenty of ice for 30 seconds and strain into a cold glass. Add a green olive on a pick. Makes four with 240ml gin and 40ml vermouth.
